baseline: training-fold class-prior probabilities with majority argmax
selection: Mean fold macro-F1, equal fold weights; ties within 1e-6 prefer lower C, then unweighted. Within each prespecified feature set only. Development estimates, not final performance.
numeric: Nonnegative age/price: log1p, fit-fold median imputation (0 if all missing), fit-fold mean/std scaling (std=1 if constant), explicit missing indicator.
categorical: String and boolean one-hot; boolean unknown distinct from false. Multi-valued strings use binary presence. Vocabulary learned only from fit-fold, unknown keys ignored and coverage reported.
probabilities: Uncalibrated OOF probabilities retained for development log loss/Brier; no probability deployed to app.
scope: E0, age-only and first E2 linear family; E3 tree, full sensitivity, calibration and final test remain future work. No imported application data used.
